lighthouse.label: Category minimums for every Lighthouse page (empty and seeded), median run.

metrics.label: Maximums for every mobile Lighthouse page, median run. Times are milliseconds; CLS has no unit.

flow.label: Worst INP of any user-flow timespan, per form factor, in milliseconds.

bundle.label: First-load JavaScript of the route in kB, counted as next build prints it. Read from the production build next to audits/, so it is checked only when that build exists and the target is served from this machine; skipped for --target live.

floors.label: Not goals: Decode's live scores measured on 2026-11-15 (results/2026-11-15-live). Dropping below one is a regression and fails the run. Raise a floor when the deployed score improves. securityLive applies to the live deployment only, since plain-HTTP local runs cannot measure TLS or headers. readableFirstMs works the other way round: the readable step's median first-visit time in milliseconds, set well above the 1.52 s measured live because throttled loads on a shared machine are noisy.

targets.label: Where these should get to: the scores at or above, readableFirstMs at or below. Reported in SUMMARY.md, never fail the run. A local build of audit-redesign scored GEO 84 on 2026-11-15.
